title: parse_structure Option<&mut Vec> signature — hard to follow without RFC context
description: walk.rs parse_structure takes text_body and html_body as &mut Option<&'a mut Vec<String>>. The function-level comment explains this models JavaScript's nullable array references from RFC 8621 §4.1.4. The signature is correct and necessary, but the reborrow pattern (*text_body = None) and the three-way Option matching make the inner loop hard to audit without re-reading the comment. Improvement: add an inline comment at the *html_body = None sites referencing RFC 8621 §4.1.4 'htmlBody = null' to make the correspondence unmistakable for a contributor reviewing just the code.
